chapter: Philadelphia and the McRae Brothers Band, 1908-1929
title: Opening of the interview, October 1981
summary: Welburn introduces the Jazz Oral History Project interview with Teddy McRae at the Institute of Jazz Studies and asks him to begin with his background.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Opening the interview: introductions, date and place

blocks.x: This is October 6, 1981 at the Institute of Jazz Studies. My name is Ron Welburn, and I'm interviewing Teddy McRae for the Jazz Oral History Project. Teddy, welcome to the Institute.

And thank you for participating in the Oral History Project. Teddy, I wonder if you would start out from the beginning -- if you could give us your full name and spell your last name. And tell us where you were born and something about your family.
